name: Xiaomi MiTV-MFTR0 (China)
summary: Xiaomi MiTV-MFTR0 (China) ships with telemetry, ads and push. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This China-market Xiaomi TV ships with telemetry, ads and push, preloaded apps, Mi Home and a cleaner. Its standby screensaver also shows ads from a downloaded carousel. Each app has its own switch in the app, so you decide which ones to turn off.

It was disabled and lived with on 22 October, and each app was checked against this firmware first. The mechanisms match the newer Redmi set. TidyTV saves a backup first and never deletes anything. TidyTV turns these apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The Menu-button panel with the source switcher
notes: The screensaver ads come from their own app, so the screensaver setting does not stop them.
Switch the TV manager back on if the voice assistant stops opening apps.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back on my Xiaomi MiTV-MFTR0?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap. TidyTV only switches apps off, so nothing is ever deleted.

faq.q: Will it stop the standby ads?
faq.a: Yes. The app that shows the screensaver ads is on the list.

faq.q: Does TidyTV delete anything on my Xiaomi MiTV-MFTR0?
faq.a: No. It turns apps off with Android's own setting, saves a backup first and checks each one. You can turn any app back on with its switch.
